captions.instagram:
How do film sound and Foley work?

Most of what you hear in a film was never recorded on set. Hang a boom mic just out of shot, snap celery for breaking bones, build a monster's roar from three layers, re-voice a line in sync, and fly a helicopter over your head in Dolby Atmos.

→ On set, a boom mic hangs just out of frame, as close to the mouth as the shot allows.
→ Double the distance and the voice drops 6 dB, but the street noise stays the same.
→ Foley artists perform footsteps in pits of gravel, wood and concrete, in time with the picture.
→ A snapped stick of celery becomes a breaking bone. Coconut shells become hooves.
→ A monster roar is built from layers: a low rumble, a mid growl and a high screech.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox.how/filmsoundclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.title: How do film sound and Foley work? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
Most of what you hear in a film was never recorded on set. Hang a boom mic just out of shot, snap celery for breaking bones, build a monster's roar from three layers, re-voice a line in sync, and fly a helicopter over your head in Dolby Atmos.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox.how/e/filmsoundclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/filmsoundclear

In this video:
• Voices on set. A shotgun mic on a boom hangs just above the frame, as close to the mouth as the shot allows.
• Foley. Footsteps, rustling clothes and small props are added later by Foley artists who watch the film and perform in sync, named after Jack Foley at Universal from 1929.
• Sound design. Sounds that cannot be recorded are built from layers: a low rumble for weight, a mid growl for character and a high screech for bite.
• ADR and dubbing. Noisy or weak lines are re-recorded in a booth to the picture: three beeps, then speak on the fourth.
• The mix. On a dubbing stage, mixers balance five stems: dialogue, music, effects, Foley and ambience, ducking the music under the words.
• In the cinema. The film arrives as a Digital Cinema Package with up to 16 uncompressed channels.
